subject.title: [Bug] Feishu plugin 2026.5.22: gateway connection timeout + QR code display broken

question: Should Feishu bot-info probing remain startup-blocking for up to 30000 ms per account, be capped/deferred off the startup-critical path, or be handled through the broader SDK/Axios egress timeout work?
rationale: The safe fix shape changes startup readiness, timeout policy, and possibly credentialed Feishu HTTP/proxy behavior; previous attempted startup-latency PRs showed gateway lifecycle regressions when this boundary was changed casually.

options.title: Cap or defer startup probe
options.body: Keep gateway account monitor lifetimes intact while moving Feishu bot-info lookup off the startup-critical path or capping it with tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Keep current blocking behavior
options.body: Accept the current 30000 ms timeout as intentional and close only after live proof shows the current behavior is acceptable for affected users.

options.title: Route through SDK timeout tracker
options.body: Treat the remaining startup symptom as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72721 and resolve the Feishu SDK/Axios egress policy there before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Cap or defer startup probe
recommendation.body: Keep gateway account monitor lifetimes intact while moving Feishu bot-info lookup off the startup-critical path or capping it with tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin contact, making them the best routing candidate for plugin startup policy.
